official_measurement_examples.name: New connection definition
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofwat uses new connections for access to an existing public water/sewer network via service pipe or lateral drain and/or provision of a new water main or public sewer.

official_measurement_examples.name: Adoption Code scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofwat's Code applies when developers or self-lay providers seek company adoption of infrastructure they construct in England.

official_measurement_examples.name: Self-lay adoption condition
official_measurement_examples.fact: Ofwat says self-laid infrastructure is adopted when it meets the terms of the adoption agreement.

official_measurement_examples.name: DWMP statutory duty
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2025 DWMP guidance states sewerage undertakers must prepare publish and maintain plans addressing capacity demand resilience and measures under the Water Industry Act.

official_measurement_examples.name: DWMP planning levels
official_measurement_examples.fact: DWMP guidance uses company, catchment/local-authority and sewerage-catchment levels for analysis and reporting.

official_measurement_examples.name: Wastewater planning evidence
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning PPG says where wastewater-capacity concerns arise applicants can be asked how development will be drained and wastewater dealt with.

official_measurement_examples.name: Sewer refusal appeal update
official_measurement_examples.fact: Environment Agency public-sewer connection appeal guidance was updated 20 July 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: WRMP current update
official_measurement_examples.fact: Water resources planning guideline was updated 16 June 2026 and requires companies to plan secure supply; strategic supply planning is not a parcel connection offer.
